rules: You have a strict ZERO-FALLBACK mandate for Git and GitHub operations.
Do NOT use direct terminal commands (git checkout, git push, gh pr) under any circumstance.
If an MCP tool fails, you must fail-closed, report the validation error, and ask the user to adjust the tool schema.
Always rely on the static schemas defined below instead of performing file-system searches or calling discovery endpoints repeatedly.
When calling 'repo.create_repair_branch', you MUST explicitly include 'writeMode': true and use 'prNumber' as the key for the target PR.
CONFLICT RESOLUTION MANDATE: If a cherry-pick, merge, or repair operation results in merge conflicts, you must NOT blindly push or open a PR with active conflicts.

You must systematically locate all conflicting files, parse the conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>), resolve the conflicts logically, clean up the files entirely (completely removing all markers), and verify that all workspace tests run and pass before initiating a pull request.
Anti-Looping Protocol: If a tool call fails twice with the exact same error, STOP immediately and ask the user for guidance. Do not blindly retry or guess parameters.
Always verify the state of the workspace (e.g., check for uncommitted changes or read the test output file) before initiating a pull request.

tools.name: repo.create_branch
tools.description: Creates a new, clean git branch from a target base branch. Use this for standard feature additions.

branchName.description: The name of the new branch (e.g., 'fix-node-version-pinned').

baseBranch.description: The source branch to branch off from.

tools.name: repo.create_repair_branch
tools.description: Creates a repair branch from an existing pull request context to resolve issues systematically.

prNumber.description: The PR number to repair/cherry-pick. Required.

writeMode.description: Must be set to true to create the repair branch.

repairBranchName.description: Desired name for the generated repair branch.

tools.name: github.checkout_branch
tools.description: Checks out an existing branch or creates a temporary workspace tracking branch under a specific worktree context.

branch.description: Name of the branch to check out.

worktreePath.description: Target absolute path of the worktree directory where checkout should occur.

tools.name: repo.run_tests
tools.description: Runs localized workspace validation tests within a specified worktree context.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to the worktree where tests will be executed.

tools.name: github.open_replacement_pr
tools.description: Opens a replacement pull request targeting main using a pre-configured, isolated repository worktree context.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to the active worktree directory containing the modified code.

originalPrNumber.description: The original PR number being replaced.

baseBranch.description: The target base branch to merge the changes into.

title.description: A clear title detailing the cherry-pick/migration action.

body.description: A detailed description explaining the migration, original context, and test verification results.

pushMode.description: Must be set to true to push the worktree branch changes and initialize the pull request automatically.

tools.name: github.create_pull_request
tools.description: Creates a pull request on GitHub using the MCP server's integrated credentials. Bypasses terminal CLI constraints.

head.description: The branch containing changes to merge.

base.description: The target branch to merge into.

tools.name: repo.get_workspace_status
tools.description: Returns the current git status, including active branch, uncommitted changes, and untracked files.

worktreePath.description: Optional absolute path to a specific worktree. Defaults to the main workspace.

tools.name: github.check_existing_prs
tools.description: Searches for open pull requests matching a specific head branch or title keyword to prevent duplicates.

headBranch.description: The branch name to check for existing open PRs.

tools.name: repo.commit_changes
tools.description: Commits staged or specified files to the current branch.

message.description: Commit message detailing the changes or conflict resolutions.

files.description: List of specific file paths to commit. If omitted or empty, commits all tracked modified files.

worktreePath.description: Optional absolute path to the worktree where the commit should occur.

tools.name: repo.push_branch
tools.description: Pushes the local branch to the remote origin.

branchName.description: The name of the local branch to push.

force.description: Whether to force push (use with extreme caution).

tools.name: github.get_merge_conflict_files
tools.description: Returns a list of files currently in a conflicted state (unmerged) in the specified worktree.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to the worktree to check for conflicts.

tools.name: repo.apply_cherry_pick
tools.description: Cherry-picks a specific commit or PR's commits onto the current active branch.

commitHash.description: The specific commit hash to cherry-pick.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path to the active worktree directory.

tools.name: repo.cleanup_worktree
tools.description: Safely removes a temporary git worktree and deletes associated local tracking branches.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path of the git worktree to delete.

branchName.description: Optional branch name to also delete locally.

tools.name: repo.fetch_updates
tools.description: Fetches remote updates from origin to compare branch heads.

worktreePath.description: Optional absolute path of the worktree to perform the fetch in.

tools.name: github.comment_issue
tools.description: Adds a follow-up comment to a GitHub issue or Pull Request.

issueNumber.description: The GitHub issue or PR ID.

body.description: The Markdown body content of the comment.

tools.name: github.get_pr_details
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive Pull Request details including labels, requested reviewers, and status.
